title: Wishbone B4 pipelined subordinate: a 256-word memory with a wait-state window, two requests outstanding with in-order acknowledges, classic cycles, ERR for the reserved region

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a request to the reserved region (address 0x800 and up) was answered with ERR; the core holds this until reset, so the bit cannot be cleared before then

notes: cyc_i, stb_i, we_i, adr_i, dat_i, sel_i, cti_i, dat_o, ack_o, stall_o, err_o and rty_o are the Wishbone B4 subordinate pins; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the subordinate's error event.

Bytes 0x000 to 0x1FF answer in the next clock, 0x200 to 0x3FF two clocks later; 0x400 to 0x7FF acknowledge with reads 0 and writes dropped; 0x800 and up answer ERR. Up to two requests are accepted ahead of their acknowledges (stall_o when two are waiting). A classic cycle (cti_i 000) holds its strobe until the acknowledge and is taken once. rty_o is never set (waived).
